info.description: The **Wirex BaaS API** enables partners to deliver non-custodial financial services directly to their retail users. Through a single integration, partners can onboard users, verify identities, issue smart wallet–linked cards, and enable crypto-backed bank transfers—without ever handling fiat or taking custody of user funds.</br>All transactions are powered by **user-owned smart wallets**, ensuring security, transparency, and full user control. Wirex acts as the infrastructure provider, so you can focus on building exceptional user experiences while we handle the heavy lifting.

tags.description:
The **Wirex BaaS API** enables partners to offer non-custodial cards and crypto-backed bank accounts to their retail users—directly from their own platforms. Powered by Wirex, this API provides secure infrastructure for onboarding users, managing wallets, and processing transactions, all while maintaining full user ownership of assets.

### Key Features:

- **Embedded Financial Services**:
  - Offer non-custodial card issuance and crypto-backed account functionality through your app or service.
  - Enable retail users to spend, send, and receive funds without relinquishing control of their assets.

- **Decentralized by Design**:
  - Every user operates with a dedicated smart wallet—no custodial risk or pooled funds.
  - Transactions are executed on-chain, ensuring full transparency and traceability.

- **Seamless Integration**:
  - Plug-and-play endpoints designed for smooth partner integration with minimal development effort.
  - Backed by detailed documentation and hands-on support from the Wirex team.

- **Compliance-Ready Infrastructure**:
  - Built-in KYC hooks, including verification flows via Sumsub.
  - Helps partners meet global compliance standards while retaining flexibility in user experience.

---

With the **Wirex BaaS API**, partners can launch next-gen financial experiences for their users—powered by Wirex’s secure and scalable infrastructure, while keeping full control over branding, user engagement, and platform design.
tags.name: Abstract

tags.description: The onboarding process in the **Wirex BaaS API** is divided into two distinct but interconnected parts: **on-chain onboarding** and **off-chain onboarding**. Both are required to enable a fully functional non-custodial user experience within the Wirex ecosystem.
tags.name: Onboarding
Onboarding/OnChain

tags.description:
Off-chain onboarding handles the **user’s presence in the Wirex backend**, allowing the system to manage non-sensitive metadata, orchestrate KYC flows, and enable services such as card issuance and transaction monitoring.

- Partners can choose between **server-side onboarding using Auth0** or **frontend integration via Privy SDK**.
- This flow includes registering the user in the off-chain system and obtaining authorization tokens for subsequent operations.

---

## Server-Side Onboarding (Auth0-Based)

### Description
This method is ideal for partners with their own backend infrastructure and existing user authentication systems. Partners collect and manage all required user information (e.g., email, wallet address, personal details) and use their **Auth0 server token** to perform onboarding actions via API.

### Key Requirements
  - Partner must have a secure authentication system in place to authorize each individual user.
  - Partner is responsible for collecting user details and ensuring data compliance.

### Typical Flow
  1. Authenticate via Auth0 to obtain a server token (see [Authorization > Auth0](#tag/Authorization/Auth0)).
  2. Register the user by making server-side API call to [Create user](#tag/User/paths/~1api~1v1~1user/post) with necessary data.
```bash
     curl --request POST \
     --url https://api-business.wirexpaychain.tech/api/v1/user \
     --header 'Authorization: Bearer {your_auth0_server_token}' \
     --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
     --data '{
     "email": "a.grey@wirexpaychain.com",
     "country": "FR",
     "wallet_address": "0x7E5F4552091A69125d5DfCb7b8C2659029395Bdf"
     }'
 ```
  3. Continue the onboarding flow (e.g., KYC, card issuance) using either [Auth0 server token authorization](#tag/Authorization/Auth0) or [Wirex token authorization](#tag/Authorization/Wirex-Pay-Token).

### Best For
Platforms that already manage their own user databases and require full backend control.

---

## Privy SDK

### Description
This method allows partners to offload identity and session management by integrating **Privy SDK** directly into their client application. Wirex provides a dedicated **AppId** that enables Privy to handle login, identity verification, and session persistence on behalf of the partner.

### Key Benefits
  - No need to implement or maintain a custom login flow.
  - Privy handles user authentication and provides tokens required for authorized API calls.
  - Reduced compliance and data handling overhead for the partner.

### Typical Flow
  1. Integrate the Privy SDK using the `AppId` provided by Wirex. For details on integrating SDK please follow [Privy SDK docs](https://docs.privy.io/basics/react/installation)
  2. Onboard the user via Privy to obtain access and identity tokens. **Please note that as a result of onboarding the registered user must have a linked email account and either a linked or an embedded wallet.**
  3. Register the user by making client-side API call to [Create retail user](#tag/User/paths/~1api~1v1~1user~1retail/post) with necessary data.
```bash
     curl --request POST \
     --url https://api-business.wirexpaychain.tech/api/v1/user/retail \
     --header 'Authorization: Bearer {your_privy_access_token}' \
     --header 'Identity: Bearer {your_privy_identity_token}' \
     --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
     --data '{
     "country": "FR"
     }'
 ```
  4. Exchange Privy tokens for a **Wirex Token** (see [Authorization > Wirex Token](#tag/Authorization/Wirex-Pay-Token)).
  5. Use the Wirex Token to complete onboarding and initiate other user-specific operations (e.g., card activation, transaction initiation).

### Best For
Partners looking for a seamless, secure, and low-maintenance user onboarding experience.

---

By supporting both **backend-driven** and **embedded identity provider** flows, the Wirex BaaS API gives you the flexibility to tailor user onboarding to your product’s architecture—without compromising on security or decentralization.
tags.name: Onboarding/OffChain

tags.description:
The **Wirex BaaS API** supports multiple authorization flows to meet varying integration needs. Whether you operate a backend system or embed authentication directly into your frontend, the platform supports flexible and secure methods for accessing user-specific resources.

---

## Anonymous

### Description
Public routes that require no authentication or authorization. These are typically informational or infrastructure-level endpoints.

### Example Use Case
Checking system status or retrieving static documentation.

---

## Auth0

### Description
Best suited for partners with their own backend, user database, and established authentication methods. This flow uses a **server-side token** to access and act on behalf of any user managed by the partner.

### How to Obtain the Token
Use the **Client Credentials Grant** flow by making a request to Auth0’s token endpoint:

```bash
curl --request POST \
  --url https://{authorization_provider_domain}/oauth/token \
  --header 'content-type: application/json' \
  --data '{
    "client_id": "{your_client_id}",
    "client_secret": "{your_client_secret}",
    "audience": "{api_host_you_want_to_access}",
    "grant_type": "client_credentials"
}'
```

**Example for Wirex BaaS Sandbox**:

```bash
curl --request POST \
  --url https://wirex-pay-dev.eu.auth0.com/oauth/token \
  --header 'content-type: application/json' \
  --data '{
    "client_id": "{your_client_id}",
    "client_secret": "{your_client_secret}",
    "audience": "https://api-business.wirexpaychain.tech",
    "grant_type": "client_credentials"
}'
```

**Example Response**:

```json
{
  "access_token": "{your_access_token}",
  "token_type": "Bearer",
  "expires_in": 86400
}
```

### Required authorization credentials
- **Authorization**: Auth0 server access token.
- One of:
    - **X-User-Email**: Email associated with the user on whos behalf the request should be made.
    - **X-User-Wallet**: Crypto wallet address associated with the user on whos behalf the request should be made.
    - **X-User-Id**: Wirex system identifier of the user.
- **X-Chain-Id**: EIP155 id of the chain for which you want this request to be executed

### Use Cases
- Performing any requests on behalf of **any** the user
- Registering new users

---

## Wirex Token

### Description
This token is issued by **Wirex** and is tied to a specific user. It’s used to authorize direct, user-specific operations—typically in frontend or delegated flows.

### How to Obtain the Token
You can obtain a Wirex token in two ways:

#### Using Auth0 Server Token
Please see [Authorization->Auth0](#tag/Authorization/Auth0) section for details on how to obtain Auth0 server token. Once obtained you can exchange it for a Wirex token by calling the dedicated endpoint [`POST /api/v1/user/authorize`](#tag/User/paths/~1api~1v1~1user~1authorize/post).
You'll need:
  - **Authorization**: Auth0 server access token.
  - One of:
      - **X-User-Email**: Email associated with the user on whos behalf the request should be made.
      - **X-User-Wallet**: Crypto wallet address associated with the user on whos behalf the request should be made.
      - **X-User-Id**: Wirex system identifier of the user.
  - **X-Chain-Id**: EIP155 id of the chain for which you want this request to be executed

       #### Example:

       ```bash
       curl --request POST \
         --url https://api-business.wirexpaychain.tech/api/v1/user/authorize \
         --header 'Authorization: Bearer {your_auth0_access_token}' \
         --header 'X-User-Email: a.grey@wirexpaychain.com' \
         --header 'X-Chain-Id: 1001996' \
         --header 'Content-Type: application/json'
       ```

       **Response:**
       ```json
       {
         "token": "{wirex_pay_user_token}"
       }
       ```

#### Using Privy SDK  
Please see [Onboarding->Privy](#tag/OnboardingOffChain/Privy-SDK) section for details on integrating Privy SDK into your application. Once integrated you can use its hooks to obtain Access and Identity tokens with a call that would look something like this
```javascript
import {useIdentityToken, useToken, usePrivy} from '@privy-io/react-auth';

function getPrivyTokens() {
  const {getAccessToken} = useToken();
  const {identityToken} = useIdentityToken();
  const {ready, user} = usePrivy();
  useEffect(() => {
    if (user && ready) {
      getAccessToken().then((accessToken) => {
        console.log('access token: ', accessToken);
        console.log('identity token: ', identityToken);
      });
    }
  }, [ready, user]);
}
```
Once obtained you can exchange them for a Wirex token by calling the dedicated endpoint [`POST /api/v1/user/authorize`](#tag/User/paths/~1api~1v1~1user~1authorize/post).
You'll need:
- **Authorization**: Your Privy Access token
- **Identity**: Your Privy Identity token
- **X-Chain-Id**: EIP155 id of the chain for which you want this session to be effective for

  #### Example:

   ```bash
   curl --request POST \
     --url https://api-business.wirexpaychain.tech/api/v1/user/authorize \
     --header 'Authorization: Bearer {your_privy_access_token}' \
     --header 'Identity: Bearer {your_privy_identity_token}' \
     --header 'X-Chain-Id: 1001996' \
     --header 'Content-Type: application/json'
   ```

  **Response:**
   ```json
   {
     "token": "{wirex_pay_user_token}"
   }
   ```

### Required authorization credentials
- **Authorization**: Token issued using one of two methods described above

### Use Cases
- Performing any API requests **on behalf of a specific user**

---

## Summary of Authorization Flows

| **Flow Type**   | **Headers**                                                                                          | **Use Case**                                                   |
|-----------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------|
| Anonymous       | None                                                                                                 | Public routes, no authentication required                      |
| Auth0           | **Authorization** (Auth0 server token) + **(X-User-Email/X-User-Wallet/X-User-Id)** + **X-Chain-Id** | Server-side access to perform operations on behalf of any user |
| Wirex Token | **Authorization** (user token)                                                                       | Frontend or delegated access for specific user actions         |
tags.name: Authorization

tags.description:
The **KYC section** of the Wirex BaaS API enables partners to seamlessly integrate user identity verification into their onboarding flow using **SumSub**. It provides tools for both **forward-facing verification** (users submit their KYC data) and **reverse sharing** (partners retrieve submitted KYC data).

---

### Key Features

- **SumSub SDK Integration**:
  - Generate a secure **SumSub SDK token** to embed the identity verification widget directly into your frontend.
  - Alternatively, retrieve a **hosted SumSub redirect link** to send users to a pre-built verification experience.

- **Flexible Verification Options**:
  - Support for both embedded and redirect-based SumSub experiences.
  - Allows partners to choose the UX that best fits their product architecture.

- **KYC Data Access via Sharing Token**:
  - Retrieve a **SumSub sharing token** that grants read-only access to KYC data previously submitted by the user.
  - Enables compliance, reporting, or customer support flows on the partner side.

---

By leveraging this section, partners can provide a secure and compliant identity verification experience for users while maintaining flexibility in how and where KYC is presented. Wirex handles all backend integration with SumSub, so partners can focus on delivering a smooth user journey.
tags.name: KYC

tags.description:
The **User Management APIs** provide partners with essential tools to manage user identity and contact information within the Wirex ecosystem. These endpoints are focused on reading user profiles, updating key data, and confirming contact details to ensure a secure and compliant user experience.

---

### Key Features:

- **User Data Retrieval**:
  - Fetch detailed user profile information, including status, identifiers, and associated wallet data.
  - Ensure your system remains synchronized with the Wirex platform.

- **Phone Number Management**:
  - Update a user’s phone number with support for country codes and formatting.
  - Supports user-driven or admin-initiated contact information updates.

- **Phone Number Confirmation**:
  - Confirm the user’s phone number via OTP-based verification.
  - Ensures that users have validated, active contact details for compliance and support purposes.

---

By integrating these User APIs, partners can maintain accurate user records, streamline contact verification, and enhance the overall reliability and integrity of user data within their applications.
tags.name: User Management

tags.description: The **Wallet APIs** provide you with an ability to read details of your on-chain AA wallet including its address and balances
tags.name: Wallet

tags.description:
The **Confirmation APIs** enable partners to securely validate user actions through OTP-based verification mechanisms. These endpoints support SMS delivery and OTP token exchange, ensuring end-user authorization for sensitive operations.

### Key Features:

- **OTP via SMS**:
  - Trigger the sending of an OTP code via SMS to the user’s registered phone number.
  - Designed to support actions such as phone verification or viewing sensitive card details.

- **Secure Verification Flow**:
  - Verify the submitted OTP code and receive an action token in return.
  - Ensures that only authorized users can complete critical operations.

- **Action-Based Context**:
  - Each OTP session is linked to a specific action type (e.g., verifying phone or accessing card data).
  - Prevents unauthorized use of tokens outside their intended context.

---

With the Confirmation APIs, partners can implement robust second-factor verification flows that protect sensitive user operations, enhance compliance, and build trust with minimal integration overhead.
tags.name: Confirmation

tags.description:
The **Card API** allows partners to seamlessly issue and manage virtual or plastic cards for retail users via a non-custodial wallet infrastructure. It supports the full card lifecycle, from issuance and activation to spending controls and secure card data access—all designed for scalable partner integration.

### Key Features:

- **Retail Card Issuance**:
  - Instantly issue virtual or plastic cards for retail users.
  - Support for user-defined card names and physical delivery with address and courier preferences.
  - Designed for smooth partner onboarding and activation flows.

- **Lifecycle Management**:
  - Activate cards securely using last four digits and expiry date confirmation.
  - Enable, disable, or deactivate cards via API to maintain full control.

- **Spending Limit Configuration**:
  - Provide user with spending controls to limit the amount that can be withdrawn from the account in one day.

- **Wallet-Based Payments**:
  - All issued cards are linked to a user's smart wallet for non-custodial, on-chain payment support.

- **Secure Card Data Access**:
  - Retrieve sensitive card information using secure, permissioned API flows backed by user confirmation and smart contract validation.

---
tags.name: Cards

tags.description:
The **Card APIs** supports two card generations, enabling partners to choose between isolated wallet flows or unified abstraction models for simplified fund management.

---

### Generation 1 (Gen1) Cards

Gen1 cards use a dedicated smart wallet per card. Users must fund the wallet directly to use their card for payments.

1. Each card issuance results in a unique smart wallet.
2. Manual user transfers are required to fund the wallet before use.
3. Transactions are processed based on the card-specific balance.

> **⚠ Deprecation Notice:** Support for Generation 1 (Gen1) Cards will be deprecated. Partners are strongly
encouraged to transition to Generation 2 (Gen2) Cards to ensure continued support and access to enhanced features.

---

### Generation 2 (Gen2) Cards

Gen2 cards connect to a unified Account Abstraction model, streamlining fund management by using a single wallet per user.

1. A unified Account Abstraction is created for the user to support Gen2 cards.
2. If unavailable, the system automatically falls back to the Gen1 model.
3. All Gen2 payments are deducted from the user's Account Abstraction wallet.

**Key Points:**

- Recommended for partners seeking seamless, low-friction card usage.
- Simplifies wallet funding and improves user experience at scale.

---

With the Card API, partners can deliver modern card experiences for retail users—whether issuing thousands of cards, integrating KYB/KYC flows, or enabling secure, blockchain-backed payments in a non-custodial environment.
tags.name: Cards/Generations Overview

tags.description:
The **Card Issuance API** enables the seamless issuance and management of both virtual and physical cards. Virtual cards can be generated
instantly and are ideal for secure online transactions. Physical cards are produced and securely shipped to end-users, with measures in
place to ensure safety during transit. One such measure is activation upon delivery, which prevents unauthorized use or fraudulent spending
while the card is in transit.
tags.name: Cards/Issuance

tags.description: The **Card Management APIs** facilitate key lifecycle operations, including activation, status modifications (enable, disable, close) and spending limit management.
tags.name: Cards/Management

tags.description:
The **Card Details APIs** enable secure access to sensitive card information, including full PAN, CVV, and expiry date.  
Access is strictly controlled, audited, and permitted only through secure, authorized channels in full compliance with PCI DSS standards.

> **Note:** To obtain card details, each request must include a valid **action token** generated through
> the [Confirmation](#tag/Confirmation) process.  
> This mechanism ensures the cardholder has explicitly authorized the operation using their private key.
tags.name: Cards/Details

tags.description:
The **Card Fees APIs** provide comprehensive details about card issuance fees incurred by the company to process a card order.  
This includes a breakdown of costs, applicable currencies, and any dynamic pricing rules configured for the account.

> **Note:** This section is applicable only if your account manager has advised you to incorporate card fee handling as part of your integration process.
tags.name: Cards/Fees

tags.description:
The **Card Delivery APIs** provide details of available delivery providers and their associated costs for physical (non-virtual) card
orders.  
They support region-based delivery rules and courier-specific pricing structures.

> **Note:** Include this section only if your account manager has specifically requested delivery option selection as part of your card
> issuance process.
tags.name: Cards/Delivery

tags.description:
The **Card 3DS APIs** enable clients to securely manage 3D Secure (3DS) authentication requests initiated during card transactions.

### Key Capabilities

- **Retrieve Active Challenges**: Access pending 3DS requests that require user action.
- **Approve or Reject**: Handle a specific challenge using an action token acquired from the [Confirmation](#tag/Confirmation) section.

### Security

All challenge responses require a valid, signed action token to confirm that the user has explicitly authorized the operation with their
private key.

> This section ensures robust authentication for sensitive card activities, preventing unauthorized use and supporting compliance with 3DS protocols.
tags.name: Cards/3DS

tags.description:
The **Bank APIs** section bridges traditional Web2 banking with non-custodial Web3 wallets using Account Abstraction (AA).

- **Automatic Account Creation**: All supported accounts would be created automatically upon registration. The user would be able to access their account details and manage their funds through the AA wallet. 

- **Fiat to Crypto**: Users can transfer fiat (EUR/GBP) from a traditional bank account to provided account details. The funds are automatically converted and deposited into their AA wallet as cryptocurrency.

- **Crypto to Fiat**: Users can send crypto from their AA wallet, which is converted and delivered as fiat to a traditional bank account (via IBAN, sort code, etc.).

This allows seamless value transfer between fiat and crypto systems while maintaining full user custody and control via smart contract wallets.
tags.name: Bank

tags.description:
The **Activity Feed APIs** enable partners to access a detailed, chronological view of a retail user's actions within the platform. These APIs provide transparency into key transactional and operational events, helping partners deliver real-time insights and enhanced user experiences.

### Key Features:

- **Comprehensive Activity Tracking**:
    - Access a full history of user activity, including payments, transfers, and operational events.
    - Ensure transparency across key user interactions with the platform.

- **Event Filtering & Categorization**:
    - Filter activities by action type (e.g., card payment, bank transfer) and activity subject (e.g., card, account).
    - Enable tailored views of user behavior for reporting or support use cases.

- **Chronological Feed Structure**:
    - Events are presented in a time-ordered format for clear activity timelines.
    - Easily integrate with user dashboards or support tools.

- **Real-Time Synchronization**:
    - Designed for near real-time updates to reflect the most recent user actions.
    - Ideal for monitoring recent transactions or building dynamic activity interfaces.

---

With the Activity Feed APIs, partners gain a powerful tool to monitor user behavior, enhance visibility into platform usage, and build features that promote trust, engagement, and support responsiveness.
tags.name: Activity Feed

tags.description:
The **Recipient APIs** provides a powerful interface for managing recipients and their payment details within a corporate environment. It enables seamless integration between fiat and crypto payout infrastructures, ensuring precise and compliant value transfers.

### Key Features:

- **Unified Recipient Management**:
    - Create and maintain recipient profiles for individuals and businesses with full support for KYC-aligned data structures.
    - Associate multiple payment methods per recipient to support complex disbursement needs.

- **Multi-Rail Payment Details Support**:
    - Add, update, and manage multiple payment methods per recipient, including SEPA, SWIFT, ACH, Faster Payments, cards, and crypto addresses.
    - Enforces field requirements dynamically based on payment method and recipient type.

- **Searchable & Scalable**:
    - Query recipients by name, currency, type, or catalog ID.
    - Optimized for high-volume use cases such as payroll, treasury, affiliate, and reward payouts.

- **Built-in Format & Compliance Checks**:
    - Enforces formatting and structure rules for IBANs, BICs, sort codes, routing numbers, PANs, and more.
    - Reduces manual QA and ensures readiness for downstream processing.

---

The Recipient API is designed for fintech platforms that require precision, speed, and flexibility in managing payees. Whether you're sending funds on-chain or off-chain, this section ensures your recipients are always payout-ready.
tags.name: Recipients

tags.description:
The **Rate APIs** offers real-time access to currency and token exchange rates based on a list of requested tickers. This API enables partners to retrieve precise conversion rates for assets supported by the platform, supporting pricing, trading, and balance calculations.

### Key Features:

- **Batch Ticker Support**:
    - Retrieve exchange rates for multiple tickers in a single request.
    - Designed for efficient use in dashboards, pricing engines, or portfolio summaries.

- **Real-Time Rate Data**:
    - Get the latest exchange rates between fiat currencies and supported crypto assets.
    - Optimized for high-frequency access with minimal latency.

---

With the Rate API, partners can offer accurate and dynamic asset pricing, power user interfaces with live data, and support conversion logic across a wide range of assets.
tags.name: Rates

tags.description:
The **Transaction APIs** offers functionality to read card transactions.

### Important:

This API is **deprecated** and should no longer be used.  
Please use the [Activity Feed](#tag/Activity-Feed) section instead, which provides improved capabilities for accessing and managing transaction data.
tags.name: Transactions

tags.description:
This API section exists solely for testing purposes. It is not intended to be used in production. Or anywhere else for that matter. If you
see it, pretend it’s a magical unicorn and walk away slowly.
tags.name: Test
